name: Marquis Los Cabos
insider_take: Where desert meets sea in spectacular fashion, this all-suite sanctuary sits on the dramatic cliffs of Cabo's golden corridor.
whats_special: This Leading Hotels property features Mexico's largest spa and the iconic Cabo Azul restaurant suspended over the Pacific. The hotel's architecture seamlessly blends into the desert landscape while offering unobstructed views of Land's End and the famous Arch of Cabo San Lucas.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Dos Mares - the infinity pool appears to merge with the ocean horizon, creating an Instagram-worthy backdrop that rivals any celebrity hotspot.
dont_miss: The weekly fire show on the beach and whale watching from your suite balcony during migration season (December-April). The hotel's private beach offers some of the best snorkeling in Los Cabos, with tropical fish visible just steps from shore.
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with panoramic Sea of Cortez views
All-suite accommodations with spacious layouts and luxury amenities
Multiple world-class dining venues and bars
